mbpp_0844.reference_description: Write a java function to find the kth element in an array containing odd elements first and then even elements.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the kth element in an array containing odd elements first and then even elements.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code builds an array of numbers from 1 to n by first listing all odd numbers in ascending order, then all even numbers in ascending order, and returns the k-th element (1-based) of this reordered sequence.

mbpp_0289.reference_description: Write a java function to calculate the number of odd days in a given year.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to calculate the number of odd days in a given year.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: OddDaysCalculator
Main goal: Determine the number of odd days (days modulo 7) after N years by applying Gregorian leap year rules. It computes the effective number of leap years L = floor(N/4) - floor(N/100) + floor(N/400) and returns (N + L) mod 7, representing total days modulo 7 for N years.

mbpp_0631.reference_description: Write a function to replace whitespaces with an underscore and vice versa in a given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to replace whitespaces with an underscore and vice versa in a given string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Swap spaces and underscores in a string
Main goal: Given a string, replace every space with an underscore and every underscore with a space, effectively swapping the two characters throughout the text. It uses a regex [ _] to locate spaces or underscores and builds the result with Matcher.appendReplacement/appendTail.

mbpp_0709.reference_description: Write a function to count unique keys for each value present in the tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count unique keys for each value present in the tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Given a list of SimpleEntry<K,V>, the code builds a mapping from each value V to the number of distinct keys K that map to it. It returns a Map<V,Integer> where each V is associated with the count of unique K keys that have that V as their value.

mbpp_0005.reference_description: Write a function to find the number of ways to fill it with 2 x 1 dominoes for the given 3 x n board.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the number of ways to fill it with 2 x 1 dominoes for the given 3 x n board.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Dynamic programming tiling of a 2×n board with dominoes and L-trominoes
Main goal: Compute the number of ways to completely tile a 2×n rectangle using 2×1 dominoes and L-shaped trominoes. It uses two DP arrays: A[i] = ways to tile 2×i completely, B[i] = ways to tile 2×i with a notch on the right edge. Recurrences: A[i] = A[i−2] + 2*B[i−1], B[i] = A[i−1] + B[i−2], with base values A[0]=1, A[1]=0, B[0]=0, B[1]=1. The function returns A[n]. Time complexity O(n), space complexity O(n).

mbpp_0645.reference_description: Write a function to find the product of it’s kth index in the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the product of it’s kth index in the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the product of the K-th elements from each sublist by extracting the K-th element from every sublist and multiplying them together.

mbpp_0045.reference_description: Write a function to find the gcd of the given array elements.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the gcd of the given array elements.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: GCDUtil provides two methods: findGcd computes the greatest common divisor of two integers using the Euclidean algorithm, and getGcd computes the gcd of an array by iteratively applying findGcd across all elements (starting with the first two). It assumes the array has at least two elements and typically positive integers for correct non-negative results.

mbpp_0823.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given string starts with a substring using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given string starts with a substring using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SubstringChecker - determine containment and starting position of a substring
Main goal: Given a string and a sample, check if the string contains the sample; if it does, verify whether the string starts with that sample (via a regex anchored at the start) and return one of three messages accordingly.

mbpp_0114.reference_description: Write a function to assign frequency to each tuple in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to assign frequency to each tuple in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sublist Frequency Augmentation

Main goal: Given a list of integer lists, count how many times each distinct sublist (based on contents) appears, and produce a string representation of a list where each unique sublist is extended by its frequency as the last element. The result preserves the original order of first appearances.

mbpp_0057.reference_description: Write a java function to find the largest number that can be formed with the given digits.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the largest number that can be formed with the given digits.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Form the maximum number by arranging digits in descending order
Main goal: Given an array of digits (0-9), sort them in descending order and concatenate them to form the largest possible number, returned as a long.

mbpp_0164.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the sum of divisors are same or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the sum of divisors are same or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: DivisorUtils. Main goal: provide utilities to compute the sum of proper divisors of a number and to compare two numbers by that sum. divSum(n) returns the sum of all divisors of n excluding n itself (starting from 1 and adding paired divisors up to sqrt(n)); areEquivalent(a, b) checks if divSum(a) == divSum(b).

mbpp_0662.reference_description: Write a function to sort array in map.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sort array in map.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SortedDictUtil.sortedDict
Main goal: Given a Map<K, List<V>> (with V comparable), produce a new Map<K, List<V>> where each value list is a sorted copy of the original (in natural ascending order). The method copies lists to avoid mutating the input and uses a HashMap for the result (no guaranteed key order).

mbpp_0658.reference_description: Write a function to find the item with maximum occurrences in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the item with maximum occurrences in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: MaxOccurrences - find the most frequent element in a list
Main goal: Given a list, return the element that occurs most often (the mode). It iterates through items, uses Collections.frequency to count each item's occurrences, and keeps the item with the highest count (ties keep the first seen). Note: will throw if the list is empty.

mbpp_0220.reference_description: Write a function to replace maximum n occurrences of spaces, commas, or dots with a colon.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to replace maximum n occurrences of spaces, commas, or dots with a colon.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: replaceMaxSpecialchar - A string transformation utility. Main goal: replace up to n occurrences of space, comma, or dot characters in the input text with colons (":" ), leaving the rest of the string unchanged.

mbpp_0217.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first repeated character in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first repeated character in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: First Repeated Character Finder
Goal: Scan the input string from left to right and return the first character that appears more than once; it uses a HashSet to track seen characters and returns '\0' if no repeated character exists.

mbpp_0895.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum sum of subsequences of given array with no adjacent elements.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum sum of subsequences of given array with no adjacent elements.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Maximal sum of a non-adjacent subsequence
Main goal: Compute the largest possible sum obtainable from a subsequence of the input array such that no two chosen elements are adjacent, using dynamic programming.
Notes: Uses a DP array lookUp where lookUp[i] stores the best sum up to index i. Initialization: lookUp[0] = A[0], lookUp[1] = max(A[0], A[1]). For i >= 2, updates with lookUp[i] = max(lookUp[i-1], lookUp[i-2] + A[i]); and ensures A[i] alone is considered via lookUp[i] = max(lookUp[i], A[i]). Returns lookUp[n-1].

mbpp_0707.reference_description: Write a java function to count the total set bits from 1 to n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the total set bits from 1 to n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Main goal: Count the total number of set bits (1s) in the binary representations of all integers from 0 to n (inclusive). The method loops over powers of two, adding the number of ones contributed by complete bit-cycles and any remaining partial cycle using a per-bit arithmetic formula, yielding O(log n) time.

mbpp_0786.reference_description: Write a function to locate the right insertion point for a specified value in sorted order.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to locate the right insertion point for a specified value in sorted order.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Binary upper-bound insertion point in a sorted list
Main goal: For a sorted List<T>, compute the index where x should be inserted to maintain order (the first index with a.get(i) > x), effectively the count of elements <= x (the upper bound). The method returns this insertion index using a binary search over the list.

mbpp_0958.reference_description: Write a function to convert an integer into a roman numeral.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert an integer into a roman numeral.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Roman numeral converter (intToRoman)

Main goal: Convert a positive integer to its Roman numeral representation using a greedy algorithm. It uses parallel arrays of values and symbols (e.g., 1000 -> "M", 900 -> "CM", etc.), iterating from largest to smallest and appending symbols while subtracting their values until the remaining number is zero.

mbpp_0155.reference_description: Write a java function to toggle all even bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to toggle all even bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Toggle odd-position bits of a non-negative integer
Main goal: Build a mask with 1s at all odd bit indices (1,3,5,...) up to the highest set bit of n, then XOR n with that mask to flip those bits.

mbpp_0169.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the nth pell number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate the nth pell number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
PellCalculator — Computes the n-th Pell number P_n using an iterative approach. Goal: Given n (n ≥ 1), return P_n where P_1 = 1, P_2 = 2, and P_n = 2*P_{n-1} + P_{n-2} for n ≥ 3.

How it works: If n ≤ 2, it returns n directly. Otherwise it initializes a = 1 (P_1) and b = 2 (P_2), then iterates from i = 3 to n computing c = 2*b + a, updates a = b and b = c. After the loop, b is P_n and is returned. Uses long to support larger values and runs in O(n) time with O(1) additional space.

mbpp_0200.reference_description: Write a function to find all index positions of the maximum values in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all index positions of the maximum values in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: PositionMax — locate all indices of the maximum value in a list
Main goal: Compute the maximum value in the input list and return a list of all indices where that maximum value appears (0-based). It works by first finding maxVal with Collections.max(list1) and then scanning to collect indices i where list1.get(i).equals(maxVal). Note: may throw exceptions for null or empty input.

mbpp_0048.reference_description: Write a java function to set all odd bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to set all odd bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Set even-position bits of n and combine with n
Main goal: Build a mask containing 1s at all even bit indices (0, 2, 4, ...) up to the most significant bit of n, then return n OR mask. The result is a number where all even-positioned bits within n’s width are set to 1, while the odd bits keep their original values from n.

mbpp_0305.reference_description: Write a function to match two words from array of words starting with letter 'p'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to match two words from array of words starting with letter 'p'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: WordMatcher - extract two P-starting words at the start of a string
Main goal: Iterate over a list of strings to find the first string that begins with two words starting with 'P' separated by a non-word character, and return those two words as a two-element array; if none are found, return null. It uses the regex "(P\\w+)\\W(P\\w+)" with lookAt() to ensure the match starts at the beginning of the string.

mbpp_0246.reference_description: Write a function for computing square roots using the babylonian method.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function for computing square roots using the babylonian method.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Implements the Babylonian (Heron's) method to approximate the square root of a non‑negative number. It starts with an initial guess of number/2, then repeatedly updates g to (g + number/g)/2 until two consecutive guesses stabilize, returning the result (0 for input 0). It does not handle negative inputs.

mbpp_0218.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum operations required to make two numbers equal.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum operations required to make two numbers equal.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Compute a gcd-based operation count for two integers
Main goal: For two positive integers A and B, the code returns (B / gcd(A,B)) - 1 after ensuring A <= B. It uses Euclid's algorithm to compute gcd(A,B), then divides B by that gcd and subtracts 1.
Functions:
- minOperations(A, B): swaps A and B if needed to guarantee A <= B, computes g = gcd(A, B), updates B to B/g, returns B - 1.
- gcd(a, b): recursive Euclidean algorithm to compute the greatest common divisor.

mbpp_0235.reference_description: Write a java function to set all even bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to set all even bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Mask-based augmentation by setting odd bit positions
Main goal: For a given non-negative integer n, compute n OR a mask that has 1s at all odd bit positions (1, 3, 5, ...) up to the most-significant set bit of n. The code builds this mask by scanning bits of n and setting bits at odd indices, then returns n | mask. Note: the function name suggests “even bits,” but it actually affects odd-indexed bits. Edge cases: n == 0 yields 0; negative n is returned unchanged. Time complexity: O(number of bits in n).

mbpp_0322.reference_description: Write a function to find all index positions of the minimum values in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all index positions of the minimum values in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Indices of the minimum value
Main goal: Given a List<Integer>, find the smallest value and return a list of all indices where that minimum occurs (handles duplicates). Note: may throw on null or empty input.

mbpp_0363.reference_description: Write a function to add the k elements to each element in the tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add the k elements to each element in the tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The method addKElement takes a list of integer lists and an integer K, and returns a new list of lists where every element is increased by K; it creates new inner lists with each value plus K, preserving the original nested list structure without mutating the input.

mbpp_0383.reference_description: Write a java function to toggle all odd bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to toggle all odd bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Toggle even-indexed bits of a number: The function evenBitToggleNumber(n) builds a mask that has 1s at all even bit positions (0, 2, 4, ...) within the bit-length of n, and returns n xor mask, effectively flipping all even-positioned bits in n.

mbpp_0332.reference_description: Write a function to count character frequency of a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count character frequency of a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FrequencyCounter
Main goal: Compute the frequency of each character in a given string and return the results as a map.
What it does: The charFrequency(String str1) method creates and returns a Map<Character, Integer> that counts how many times each character appears in str1. It iterates over the string's characters, increments the count if the character is already present, or initializes it to 1 if not.
Notes: Uses a HashMap for storage; returns an empty map for an empty input.

mbpp_0509.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of odd numbers till a given odd number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of odd numbers till a given odd number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: For an odd n, compute the average of all odd numbers from 1 to n by summing n, n−2, ..., 1 and dividing by the count of terms. It throws IllegalArgumentException if n is even. The result equals (n+1)/2. Note: negative odd inputs lead to a division-by-zero at runtime due to no terms being processed.

mbpp_0417.reference_description: Write a function to find common first element in given array of tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find common first element in given array of tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: GroupTuples: merge lists by their first element
Main goal: Given a list of lists, group all lists that share the same first element (the key) and produce one aggregated list per key. The first occurrence's full list initializes the group, and for subsequent lists with the same key, only their trailing elements (excluding the key) are appended. The resulting list of groups preserves the keys' insertion order.

mbpp_0537.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first repeated word in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first repeated word in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: FirstRepeatedWord - Goal: Return the first word that repeats in the input string by scanning words split on whitespace; uses a HashSet to track seen words and returns the first duplicate, or "None" if no repetition exists.

mbpp_0511.reference_description: Write a java function to find minimum sum of factors of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find minimum sum of factors of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of prime factors (with multiplicity)
Main goal: Compute the sum of all prime factors of the given long number, counting duplicates (e.g., 60 -> 2 + 2 + 3 + 5 = 12). It uses trial division starting from 2, repeatedly dividing out each factor and accumulating it into the sum, up to sqrt(num); after the loop, it adds any remaining num as a factor and returns the total.

mbpp_0664.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of even numbers till a given even number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of even numbers till a given even number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Average of even numbers from n to 2
Main goal: If n is even, compute the integer average of all even numbers from n down to 2 by summing n, n-2, ..., 2 and dividing by their count; if n is odd, return -1. Note: for n = 0 this results in a division by zero (bug).

mbpp_0592.reference_description: Write a java function to find sum of product of binomial co-efficients.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find sum of product of binomial co-efficients.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BinomialProductSum

Main goal: Compute a binomial coefficient C(2n, n-1) using a space-efficient dynamic programming approach. 
- binomialCoeff(n, k): calculates C(n, k) by updating a 1D array (size k+1) in a Pascal-triangle fashion, yielding O(n·k) time and O(k) space.
- sumOfProduct(n): returns C(2n, n-1) by calling binomialCoeff(2n, n-1).

mbpp_0621.reference_description: Write a function to increment the numeric values in the given strings by k.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to increment the numeric values in the given strings by k.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Increment Numerics in a String List
Main goal: Transform a list of strings by incrementing every purely numeric element by a given integer K, while leaving non-numeric strings unchanged. Returns a new list of strings with the updated numeric values.

mbpp_0619.reference_description: Write a function to move all the numbers in it to the given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to move all the numbers in it to the given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Move digits to the end of the string. Goal: Return a new string where all non-digit characters stay in their original order and all digits are appended at the end (preserving the digits’ original order).

mbpp_0760.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether an array contains only one distinct element or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether an array contains only one distinct element or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: All-elements-same Checker
Main goal: Return "YES" if every element in arr is identical; otherwise return "NO". It builds a HashSet from the array elements and returns "YES" when the set size is 1 (i.e., all values are the same). Note: the second parameter n is unused.

mbpp_0671.reference_description: Write a java function to set the right most unset bit.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to set the right most unset bit.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
A small BitUtils helper with two operations:
- getPosOfRightmostSetBit(n): returns the 1-based position of the least significant 1 in n (based on trailing zeros).
- setRightmostUnsetBit(n): returns n with the rightmost 0 bit turned on (handles n == 0 and the all-ones case, using ~n to locate the rightmost zero).

mbpp_0780.reference_description: Write a function to find the combinations of sums with tuples in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the combinations of sums with tuples in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: For a given list of 2-element int arrays, compute all sums of every unique pair of arrays. The code iterates over all i < j pairs and for each pair constructs a new 2-element array whose elements are the sums of the corresponding components (a[0]+b[0], a[1]+b[1]), collecting these into a result list. Assumes each input array has at least two elements. Time complexity is O(n^2) with O(n^2) space for the output.

mbpp_0736.reference_description: Write a function to locate the left insertion point for a specified value in sorted order.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to locate the left insertion point for a specified value in sorted order.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: LeftInsertion (lower_bound). Main goal: Use binary search to find the leftmost insertion index for x in a sorted array a (i.e., the lower_bound). Returns the index where x would be inserted to maintain nondecreasing order (0 ≤ index ≤ a.length). Time complexity: O(log n); Space complexity: O(1).

mbpp_0083.reference_description: Write a java function to find the character made by adding all the characters of the given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the character made by adding all the characters of the given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Alphabetic sum to a single letter
Main goal: For a given lowercase string, sum each character's alphabet position (a=1 to z=26), compute the sum modulo 26, and return the corresponding lowercase letter; if the remainder is 0, return 'z'.

mbpp_0022.reference_description: Write a function to find the first duplicate element in a given array of integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the first duplicate element in a given array of integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Find First Duplicate in Array
Main goal: Return the first duplicated number encountered while scanning the array; if no duplicates exist, return -1. It uses a HashSet to track seen numbers, resulting in O(n) time and O(n) space.

mbpp_0888.reference_description: Write a function to substract the elements of the given nested tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to substract the elements of the given nested tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise subtraction of two 2D int arrays with bounded dimensions

Main goal: Compute a new 2D int array containing the element-wise differences testTup1[i][j] - testTup2[i][j], limited to the overlapping portion of the inputs. The number of rows is the minimum of the two input row counts, and for each row the number of columns is the minimum of the corresponding row lengths. The result retains those bounds and ignores any extra rows/columns from the longer inputs.

mbpp_0097.reference_description: Write a function to find frequency count of array of arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find frequency count of array of arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class FrequencyCounter with a method frequencyLists that takes a List of List of Integers and returns a map counting the total occurrences of each integer across all sublists. It iterates through every number in every sublist and updates a HashMap using getOrDefault to increment counts. The result is a frequency map: integer -> how many times it appears.

mbpp_0229.reference_description: Write a function to re-arrange the elements of the given array so that all negative elements appear before positive ones.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to re-arrange the elements of the given array so that all negative elements appear before positive ones.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: In-place reordering to group negative numbers at the front
Main goal: Move all negative elements to the beginning of the array by scanning once and swapping with a front index, performing in-place partitioning that preserves the relative order of negative numbers.

mbpp_0186.reference_description: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexUtils – checkLiterals
Main goal: Return "Matched!" if the input text contains a substring that matches any of the provided regex patterns; otherwise return "Not Matched!".
Note: The current code exits after evaluating the first pattern, so it does not check subsequent patterns (a bug). It also compiles patterns inside the loop.

mbpp_0128.reference_description: Write a function to shortlist words that are longer than n from a given array of words.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to shortlist words that are longer than n from a given array of words.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: WordFilter — Filters words longer than a given length
Main goal: Provide a method longWords(int n, String str) that splits the input string by spaces and returns a list of words whose length is greater than n. It collects qualifying words in an ArrayList and returns them as a List<String>.

mbpp_0178.reference_description: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Determine if a given text contains any of the provided regex patterns and return a verdict. Flaw: The loop returns after evaluating only the first pattern, so it never checks subsequent patterns; it returns "Matched!" if the first pattern matches, otherwise "Not Matched!" regardless of the rest. It uses Pattern.compile(pattern).matcher(text).find() to test for a match.

mbpp_0579.reference_description: Write a function to find the dissimilar elements in the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the dissimilar elements in the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Find dissimilar elements between two arrays (symmetric difference)
Main goal: Return a list of elements that appear in exactly one of the two input arrays. The method converts both arrays to sets and builds a result set containing items from arr1 not in arr2 and items from arr2 not in arr1, effectively computing the symmetric difference, then returns it as a List. Note: duplicates are ignored due to set usage, and output order is not guaranteed.

mbpp_0264.reference_description: Write a function to calculate a dog's age in dog's years.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate a dog's age in dog's years.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Provide a simple utility to convert a human age to an estimated dog age using the common rule: the first 2 human years equal 10.5 dog years each, and each additional human year equals 4 dog years. The dogAge method accepts a human age (hAge) as a double, exits the program if the input is negative, computes the corresponding dog age (dAge) using the rule, and returns it as a double. The class DogAgeCalculator encapsulates this static helper function.

mbpp_0324.reference_description: Write a function to extract the sum of alternate chains of tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract the sum of alternate chains of tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: AlternateSum: Compute two sums from an input int array: the sum of elements at odd indices and the sum of elements at even indices, returning them as a two-element array [sumOddIndices, sumEvenIndices]. The method sumOfAlternates(int[] testTuple) iterates through the array, adds elements to sum1 when the index is odd, and to sum2 when the index is even, then returns {sum1, sum2}.

mbpp_0302.reference_description: Write a java function to find the most significant bit number which is also a set bit.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the most significant bit number which is also a set bit.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Highest Power of Two (MSB) Calculator
Main goal: Given a positive integer n, return the value of its most significant set bit (i.e., the largest power of two not exceeding n); if n is 0, return 0.

mbpp_0852.reference_description: Write a java function to remove negative numbers from array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove negative numbers from array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Filter negative numbers from a list
Main goal: Remove all negative integers from the given List<Integer> in place by iterating with an Iterator and returning the modified same list.

mbpp_0752.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Jacobsthal Number Calculator
Main goal: Compute the nth Jacobsthal number using dynamic programming.

<Response:>Calculates the nth Jacobsthal number using dynamic programming: J(n) = J(n-1) + 2*J(n-2) with J(0)=0 and J(1)=1, returning J(n).</Response:>

mbpp_0824.reference_description: Write a java function to remove even numbers from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove even numbers from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: RemoveEven - Main goal: Remove all even integers from the provided List<Integer> in place by iterating with an Iterator and removing elements when they are even, then return the same list.

mbpp_0644.reference_description: Write a java function to reverse an array upto a given position.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to reverse an array upto a given position.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Reverse first k elements of a list
Main goal: Return a new List<T> where the first k elements of the input list are reversed and the remaining elements are kept in their original order (the input list itself is not modified).

mbpp_0009.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum number of rotations required to get the same string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum number of rotations required to get the same string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Smallest left-rotation index that reconstructs the string
Main goal: Find the smallest i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) such that left-rotating the string str by i positions yields the original string. It does this by concatenating str with itself (tmp = str + str) and scanning substrings of length n starting at positions 1..n, returning the first i where tmp.substring(i, i+n) equals str; if none found, returns n.

mbpp_0067.reference_description: Write a function to find the number of ways to partition a set of bell numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the number of ways to partition a set of bell numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BellNumber class computes the nth Bell number
Main goal: Use a dynamic programming Bell triangle to compute B(n). It fills a 2D array with the recurrence bell[i][j] = bell[i-1][j-1] + bell[i][j-1], initializes bell[i][0] from the previous row, starts with bell[0][0] = 1, and returns bell[n][0] as the nth Bell number.

mbpp_0868.reference_description: Write a java function to find the length of the last word in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the length of the last word in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Length of Last Word; Main goal: Given a string, return the length of its last word by trimming whitespace, then scanning characters and counting non-space characters, resetting the count whenever a space is encountered.

mbpp_0063.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum difference between available pairs in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum difference between available pairs in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Maximum absolute difference across pairs
Goal: Given a list of two-element int arrays, find the largest absolute difference between the two numbers within any pair.
How: maxDifference iterates testList, computes diff = Math.abs(pair[1] - pair[0]) for each pair, tracks the maximum in res, and returns it. Returns 0 for an empty list. Assumes each element has at least two elements (pair[0], pair[1]).

mbpp_0079.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is odd or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is odd or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: WordLenChecker.wordLen: Returns true if the first word of the input string (split by spaces) has an odd length; otherwise returns false. The loop exits after the first word, so subsequent words are ignored (leading whitespace can create empty tokens, affecting the result).

mbpp_0137.reference_description: Write a function to find the ration of zeroes in an array of integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the ration of zeroes in an array of integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ZeroCounter - zeroCount method
Main goal: Compute the fraction of elements equal to zero in an int array and return it as a double rounded to two decimals.

mbpp_0120.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Maximum absolute product among pairs

Main goal: Given a List<int[]> where each element represents a pair of integers, the code computes the absolute value of the product for each pair (abs(pair[0] * pair[1])) and returns the maximum of these values. It initializes the max with Integer.MIN_VALUE and updates it while iterating. Notes: it assumes each array has at least two elements and can suffer from overflow; it also returns Integer.MIN_VALUE if the list is empty.

mbpp_0078.reference_description: Write a java function to find number of integers with odd number of set bits.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find number of integers with odd number of set bits.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Count numbers with odd set bits up to n
Main goal: Return the number of integers in the inclusive range [0, n] that have an odd number of 1s in their binary representation. It uses the pairing property of (2i, 2i+1) where exactly one has odd bitcount, handling odd n directly as (n+1)/2 and, for even n, starting from n/2 and adding one more if the bitcount of n is odd.

mbpp_0161.reference_description: Write a function to remove all elements from a given array present in another array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove all elements from a given array present in another array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RemoveElements utility
Main goal: Return a new list containing elements from list1 that are not present in list2; it uses generics and iterates list1, filtering out any items found in list2.

mbpp_0308.reference_description: Write a function to find the specified number of largest products from two given arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the specified number of largest products from two given arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Top-N Largest Products from Two Lists
Main goal: Generate all pairwise products from two input lists, sort them in descending order, and return the first N values (or all if there are fewer than N).
Notes: Duplicates are preserved; time complexity is O(m*n log(m*n)) where m and n are the sizes of the input lists.

mbpp_0310.reference_description: Write a function to convert a given string to a tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert a given string to a tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: This code defines StringConverter.stringToTuple, which takes a string and returns a Character[] containing all non-whitespace characters in their original order. It iterates over the string, filters out whitespace using Character.isWhitespace, collects to a List<Character>, and converts it to a Character[].

mbpp_0277.reference_description: Write a function to filter map based on values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to filter map based on values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Filter map by value threshold
Main goal: Return a new map containing only the entries from the input map whose values are greater than or equal to a given threshold n. It uses generics (K for keys, V for values where V implements Comparable<V>), iterates over the entries, keeps those with value.compareTo(n) >= 0, and returns them in a new HashMap. Note: null handling is not implemented; passing nulls may throw exceptions.

mbpp_0321.reference_description: Write a function to find the demlo number for the given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the demlo number for the given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines Demlo.findDemlo, which ignores the actual input text and builds a string from the input's length l by concatenating 1..l and then l-1..1. The result is a Demlo-like palindromic number such as "123...l...(l-1)...321" (length 2l-1).

mbpp_0378.reference_description: Write a java function to shift last element to first position in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to shift last element to first position in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Move the last element to the front of a list (rotate by one)

Main goal: Implement a generic utility method moveFirst(List<T>) that returns a new list where the last element of the input list is placed at the beginning, followed by the remaining elements in their original order. If the input is null or empty, it returns the input as-is. The method does not modify the original list; it builds a new ArrayList with the appropriate elements.

mbpp_0331.reference_description: Write a java function to count unset bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count unset bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: BitUtils.countUnsetBits — Goal: Count the number of zero bits in n's binary representation from the least significant bit up to the most significant 1. It iterates over bit positions (1, 2, 4, ...) while x <= n and increments the count when (x & n) == 0, returning the total.

mbpp_0371.reference_description: Write a function to find the smallest missing element in a sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the smallest missing element in a sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code implements a binary-search-style function to find the smallest missing non-negative integer in a sorted array A, assuming A[i] >= i. It checks the middle index mid: if A[mid] == mid, it searches the right half (mid+1 to right); otherwise it searches the left half (left to mid-1). When left > right, it returns left, which is the smallest missing value (e.g., 0 if 0 is missing, or n if 0..n-1 are present).

mbpp_0409.reference_description: Write a function to find the minimum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the minimum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Find the smallest absolute product of the elements in any 2-element int array within the provided list. The code iterates through each pair, computes the absolute value of the product pair[0] * pair[1], and tracks the minimum to return it.

mbpp_0392.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum sum possible by using the given equation f(n) = max( (f(n\/2) + f(n\/3) + f(n\/4) + f(n\/5)), n).

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum sum possible by using the given equation f(n) = max( (f(n\/2) + f(n\/3) + f(n\/4) + f(n\/5)), n).
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Dynamic programming to maximize sum via division-based subproblems
Main goal: For a given n, compute the maximum obtainable sum by either taking i itself or replacing i with the sum of optimal values for i/2, i/3, i/4, and i/5, using a bottom-up DP array res[0..n]. Returns res[n]. Time O(n), space O(n). Base cases: res[0] = 0, res[1] = 1.

mbpp_0412.reference_description: Write a java function to remove odd numbers from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove odd numbers from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Remove odd numbers from a list
Main goal: Mutate the given List<Integer> by removing all odd elements in place using an Iterator, and return the same list instance.

mbpp_0394.reference_description: Write a function to check if given tuple is distinct or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if given tuple is distinct or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DistinctChecker - Checks if all elements in an array are unique.
Main goal: Determine whether the input array contains duplicates by adding each element to a HashSet and returning false on the first duplicate; returns true if all elements are distinct.

mbpp_0450.reference_description: Write a function to extract specified size of strings from a give array of string values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract specified size of strings from a give array of string values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Returns a new list containing only the strings from the input list whose length matches the specified length.

mbpp_0553.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given tuple to a floating-point number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given tuple to a floating-point number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleConverter.tupleToFloat
Main goal: Convert a list of values into a double by joining the elements with a dot as a separator and parsing the resulting string as a double. Specifically, it builds a string like "elem0.elem1" (or just "elem0" for a single element) and returns its numeric value via Double.parseDouble. Note: it will throw for lists with more than two elements or non-numeric content.

mbpp_0483.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first natural number whose factorial is divisible by x.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first natural number whose factorial is divisible by x.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FirstFactorialDivisibleNumber
Main goal: Find and return the smallest integer i such that i! is divisible by x by iteratively computing the factorial (fact) as 1*2*...*i and stopping when fact % x == 0; returns i (worst case i = x).

mbpp_0416.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum sum we can make by dividing number in three parts recursively and summing them up together for the given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum sum we can make by dividing number in three parts recursively and summing them up together for the given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: compute the maximum value obtainable from n by either using n itself or recursively breaking it into floor(n/2), floor(n/3), and floor(n/4) and summing their best values. It uses a bottom-up DP array where dp[i] = max(dp[i/2] + dp[i/3] + dp[i/4], i), with base cases dp[0] = 0 and dp[1] = 1; it returns dp[n].

mbpp_0554.reference_description: Write a java function to find odd numbers from a mixed array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find odd numbers from a mixed array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
### Title: Split – odd-number filter
### Main goal: Return a new list containing only the odd integers from the input list; the original list remains unchanged.

mbpp_0687.reference_description: Write a function to find the greatest common divisor (gcd) of two integers by using recursion.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the greatest common divisor (gcd) of two integers by using recursion.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive Euclidean GCD (recurGcd)
Main goal: Compute the greatest common divisor of two integers using a recursive Euclidean algorithm that orders inputs so the smaller value is used as the divisor, reduces via modulo, and handles base cases when the smaller value is 0 or 1.

mbpp_0629.reference_description: Write a java function to find even numbers from a mixed array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find even numbers from a mixed array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Filter evens from a list
Main goal: Return a new list containing only the even integers from the input List<Integer>, by iterating and collecting elements where i % 2 == 0.

mbpp_0691.reference_description: Write a function to group the 1st elements on the basis of 2nd elements in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to group the 1st elements on the basis of 2nd elements in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Group elements by value (preserving order)
Main goal: Given a List<SimpleEntry<K,V>> with V Comparable, produce a LinkedHashMap<V, List<K>> that groups keys K by their value V, after sorting the entries by V in ascending order; within each value, keys are collected in their original input order.

mbpp_0726.reference_description: Write a function to multiply the adjacent elements of the given tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to multiply the adjacent elements of the given tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class MultiplyAdjacent with a method multiplyElements that, given an int array, returns a new array containing the products of each pair of adjacent elements. For an input of length n, the result has length n-1 and res[i] = testArr[i] * testArr[i+1]. If the input has fewer than 2 elements, it returns an empty array.

mbpp_0875.reference_description: Write a function to find the minimum difference in the tuple pairs of given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the minimum difference in the tuple pairs of given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Min Difference in Pairs. Main goal: Given a list of 2-element int arrays, compute and return the smallest absolute difference between the two numbers within any pair in the list.

mbpp_0932.reference_description: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given array of strings.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given array of strings.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: DuplicateRemover: Remove duplicates from a List<String> by keeping only the first occurrence and preserving the original order.

mbpp_0777.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of non-repeated elements in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of non-repeated elements in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of Distinct Elements in an Array
Goal: Sorts the input array in non-decreasing order and computes the sum of all distinct elements by starting with the first element and adding a value only when it differs from the previous one; effectively returns the sum of unique values. Assumes n > 0; runs in O(n log n) time due to sorting.

mbpp_0040.reference_description: Write a function to find frequency of the elements in a given array of arrays using collections module.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find frequency of the elements in a given array of arrays using collections module.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Frequency counter for elements across nested lists
Main goal: Given a List<List<T>>, compute and return a Map<T, Integer> containing each element's total number of occurrences across all sublists.

mbpp_0003.reference_description: Write a java function to identify non-prime numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to identify non-prime numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: A utility class PrimeUtils provides isNotPrime(int n), which returns true if n has any divisor from 2 up to floor(sqrt(n)) (indicating n is not prime), and false otherwise. It sets a flag when a divisor is found during iteration. Note: it does not correctly handle n <= 1 and continues looping without short-circuiting after finding a divisor.

mbpp_0066.reference_description: Write a java function to count positive numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count positive numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: PosCounter - Counts non-negative integers in a list
Main goal: Provide a utility method posCount(List<Integer>) that counts and returns how many elements in the input list are >= 0 (including zero). It iterates the list with a for-each loop, increments a counter for each non-negative value, and returns that count. Complexity: O(n); handles empty lists.

mbpp_0964.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is even or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is even or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: WordLengthChecker - Parity of the first word's length

Main goal: Given a string, split it by spaces into words and return true if the first word has an even length, otherwise return false. Note: the code exits after checking the first word and does not examine subsequent words; it may behave unexpectedly with multiple or leading spaces.

mbpp_0090.reference_description: Write a java function to find the length of the longest word.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the length of the longest word.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The function lenLog accepts a non-empty List<String> and returns the length of the longest string in the list by scanning all strings and tracking the maximum length encountered.

mbpp_0199.reference_description: Write a java function to find highest power of 2 less than or equal to given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find highest power of 2 less than or equal to given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Largest power of two not greater than n
Main goal: Given an integer n, return the greatest power of two that is less than or equal to n. The method iterates from n down to 1 and uses the bitwise check (i & (i - 1)) == 0 to identify powers of two, returning the first match. If n <= 0, it returns 0.

mbpp_0250.reference_description: Write a java function to count the occcurences of an element in a tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the occcurences of an element in a tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Generic array value counter (TupleUtils.countX)
Main goal: Provide a static generic method that counts how many times a given value x appears in an array tup of type T, using null-safe equality.
How it works: Iterates through the array and increments a counter whenever Objects.equals(ele, x) is true; returns the final count.

mbpp_0105.reference_description: Write a java function to count true booleans in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count true booleans in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
BooleanCounter — Count true values in a List<Boolean>.
Main goal: Provide a static method count(List<Boolean> lst) that returns the number of true values by iterating the list and incrementing a counter for each element that is true (assumes non-null booleans).

mbpp_0303.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the count of inversion of two types are same or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the count of inversion of two types are same or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Non-decreasing array check
Main goal: Determine if the input array a of length n is non-decreasing by ensuring each element a[j] (for j from 1 to n-1) is at least as large as the maximum of all previous elements; returns true if this holds for all j, otherwise false.

mbpp_0326.reference_description: Write a function to get the word with most number of occurrences in the given strings array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to get the word with most number of occurrences in the given strings array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class MostOccurrences with a method mostOccurrences that takes a list of strings, splits each string into whitespace-delimited words, counts how many times each word occurs across all strings, and returns the word with the highest frequency. If there are no words, it may throw an exception; if multiple words tie for the maximum, the chosen one is arbitrary based on iteration order.

mbpp_0318.reference_description: Write a java function to find the maximum volume of a cuboid with given sum of sides.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the maximum volume of a cuboid with given sum of sides.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: For a given s, compute the maximum value of i × j × k for nonnegative integers i, j, k with i + j + k = s. The code brute-forces i and j, sets k = s − i − j, and tracks the largest product, returning it. This represents the maximum volume of a cuboid with integer edge lengths that sum to s (the optimal split is as even as possible, near s/3). Time complexity is O(s²).

mbpp_0329.reference_description: Write a java function to count negative numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count negative numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: NegCounter - Counts non-positive integers in a list
Goal: Given a List<Integer>, compute and return the count of elements that are less than or equal to zero (i.e., negative numbers and zero).

mbpp_0402.reference_description: Write a function to compute the value of ncr%p.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to compute the value of ncr%p.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Space-Optimized Computation of nCr Mod p
Main goal: Compute the binomial coefficient C(n, r) modulo p using a dynamic-programming approach (Pascal's triangle) with O(r) space. It updates a 1D array C by iterating i from 1 to n and, for j from min(i, r) down to 1, setting C[j] = (C[j] + C[j-1]) mod p. The result is C[r].

mbpp_0400.reference_description: Write a function to extract the frequency of unique tuples in the given array order irrespective.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract the frequency of unique tuples in the given array order irrespective.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Counts distinct inner lists by normalizing each sublist through sorting and then counting how many unique sorted lists exist; extractFreq returns the number of distinct multisets represented by the inner lists.

mbpp_0401.reference_description: Write a function to perform index wise addition of tuple elements in the given two nested tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform index wise addition of tuple elements in the given two nested tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: TupleAdder: Element-wise addition of two 2D int arrays (potentially jagged); returns a new 2D array where each element res[i][j] = testTup1[i][j] + testTup2[i][j]. Assumes matching shapes and does not handle shape mismatches.

mbpp_0388.reference_description: Write a java function to find the highest power of 2 that is less than or equal to n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the highest power of 2 that is less than or equal to n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Find the largest power of two not exceeding n
Goal: Given an integer n, return the greatest power of two (2^k) such that 2^k <= n; for n <= 0 the function returns 0. It does this by counting down from n to 1 and using the test (i & (i - 1)) == 0 to detect powers of two, returning the first match.

mbpp_0507.reference_description: Write a function to remove specific words from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove specific words from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RemoveWords
Main goal: Remove from the first list any words that appear in the second list and return the modified list.
Brief mechanism: Iterates over a copy of the first list to avoid concurrent modification, removing items from the original list when they are found in the removeWords list.

mbpp_0692.reference_description: Write a java function to find the last two digits in factorial of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the last two digits in factorial of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Small factorial last-two-digits calculator
Main goal: Compute the last two digits of N! by iteratively multiplying from 1 to N modulo 100, but only for N < 10; for N >= 10 it returns null (i.e., it does not compute beyond 9).

mbpp_0614.reference_description: Write a function to find the cumulative sum of all the values that are present in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the cumulative sum of all the values that are present in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Cumulative Sum Calculator for Nested Integer Lists
Goal: Provide a static method that sums every integer in a List<List<Integer>> and returns the total as an int. It traverses each inner list and accumulates values, effectively computing the global sum across all inner lists.

mbpp_0583.reference_description: Write a function for nth catalan number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function for nth catalan number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Catalan Number Calculator (Recursive)
Main goal: Compute the nth Catalan number using a naive recursive formula. The function catalanNumber(n) returns 1 when n <= 1, otherwise it sums catalanNumber(i) * catalanNumber(n-i-1) for i from 0 to n-1, storing the result in a long.

mbpp_0694.reference_description: Write a function to extract unique values from the given map values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract unique values from the given map values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ExtractUnique from map of lists
Goal: Gather all elements from the map's lists, remove duplicates using a Set, and return a sorted List of the unique elements (generic type T must be Comparable).

mbpp_0845.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of digits in factorial of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of digits in factorial of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class FactorialDigits with a static method findDigits(int n) that returns the number of decimal digits in n! (the factorial of n). It uses Kamenetsky’s formula (n*log10(n/e) + log10(2πn)/2) to estimate the digit count, taking the floor and adding 1. Special cases: returns 0 for negative n, and returns 1 for n <= 1 (0! = 1! = 1).

mbpp_0878.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains only k elements.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains only k elements.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleChecker – Verify all elements of testTuple are in K
Main goal: Provide a generic method checkTuples<T> that returns true iff every element of testTuple is contained in the given Collection<T>; otherwise false, implemented by iterating testTuple and checking K.contains for each element.

mbpp_0880.reference_description: Write a java function to find number of solutions in quadratic equation.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find number of solutions in quadratic equation.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: QuadraticSolver
Main goal: Determine the number of real roots of a quadratic equation ax^2 + bx + c = 0 by computing the discriminant (b^2 - 4ac) and returning "2 solutions", "1 solution", or "No solutions" accordingly (assuming a != 0).

mbpp_0947.reference_description: Write a java function to find the length of the shortest word.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the length of the shortest word.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Compute minimum word length from a list
Main goal: Return the smallest length among the strings in the provided List<String>.
How it works: Initializes min with the first string's length, iterates through the list updating min when a shorter length is found, and returns min. May fail on null or empty lists.

mbpp_0109.reference_description: Write a java function to find the count of rotations of a binary string with odd value.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the count of rotations of a binary string with odd value.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Count ones in the prefix of a binary string
Main goal: Given a string s and an integer n, return how many characters among the first n positions are '1'. It iterates i from 0 to n-1, increments a counter for each '1', and returns the count. Assumes n <= s.length() to avoid an exception.

mbpp_0091.reference_description: Write a function to check if a substring is present in a given array of string values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if a substring is present in a given array of string values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
SubstringFinder
Main goal: Provide a method that iterates a list of strings and returns true if any element contains the given substring; otherwise returns false.

mbpp_0100.reference_description: Write a function to find the next smallest palindrome of a specified number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the next smallest palindrome of a specified number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Brute-force Next Palindrome Finder
Main goal: Given a long input, find the smallest decimal palindrome strictly greater than it by incrementing from num+1 and checking each candidate’s string representation for palindrome-ness (via reversing the string). Returns that palindrome, or -1 if none exists up to Long.MAX_VALUE.

mbpp_0168.reference_description: Write a java function to find the frequency of a number in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the frequency of a number in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: FrequencyFinder: a utility class with a static method frequency(int[] a, int x) that counts and returns how many times x appears in the array a by iterating through all elements and incrementing a counter on each match.

mbpp_0202.reference_description: Write a function to remove even characters in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove even characters in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Keep every other character (odd positions) from a string

Main goal: The method removeEven takes a string and returns a new string consisting of characters at the 1st, 3rd, 5th, etc. positions (i.e., odd indices in 0-based counting). It iterates with a 1-based index and appends characters when the index is odd. Note: the method name is misleading; it actually removes characters at even positions.

mbpp_0204.reference_description: Write a java function to count the occurrence of a given character in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the occurrence of a given character in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Summary_description
Title: Counter for Character Occurrences
Main goal: Provide a method count(s, c) that iterates through string s and returns how many times the character c appears.

mbpp_0221.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first even number in a given array of numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first even number in a given array of numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a utility class FirstEvenFinder with a static method firstEven that returns the first even integer from a given list. It iterates over the list and returns the first number divisible by 2; if no even number is found, it returns -1.

mbpp_0295.reference_description: Write a function to return the sum of all divisors of a number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to return the sum of all divisors of a number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SumDivisors
Main goal: Compute the sum of proper divisors of a given positive integer (excluding the number itself).
What it does: sumDiv(int number) initializes sum to 1 (accounting for the divisor 1), then iterates i from 2 up to number-1 and adds i to sum whenever number % i == 0. Returns the final sum.
Notes: Assumes number > 1. For number <= 1 the result is not meaningful (returns 1). Time complexity: O(n); Space complexity: O(1).

mbpp_0270.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of even numbers at even positions.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of even numbers at even positions.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of even numbers at even indices
Main goal: Compute the sum of elements at even indices (0, 2, 4, ...) among the first n elements of the array that are even numbers themselves.

mbpp_0288.reference_description: Write a function to count array elements having modular inverse under given prime number p equal to itself.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count array elements having modular inverse under given prime number p equal to itself.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Counting elements with square equal to 1 modulo P
Main goal: To count how many of the first N integers in array arr satisfy arr[i]^2 ≡ 1 (mod P). The function modularInverse iterates through the array and increments a counter when (arr[i] * arr[i]) % P == 1, returning that count. Note: despite the name, it does not compute an actual modular inverse.

mbpp_0226.reference_description: Write a java function to remove the characters which have odd index values of a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove the characters which have odd index values of a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Even-indexed character extractor
Main goal: Produce a string made of characters from the input located at even indices (0, 2, 4, ...); it iterates over the input and appends those chars to a StringBuilder.

mbpp_0389.reference_description: Write a function to find the n'th lucas number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the n'th lucas number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive Lucas Number Calculator
Main goal: Compute the nth Lucas number using naive recursion, with base cases L(0)=2 and L(1)=1 and the relation L(n)=L(n-1)+L(n-2). Note: no memoization, exponential time, and potential integer overflow for larger n.

mbpp_0313.reference_description: Write a java function to print positive numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to print positive numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Return the first non-negative Integer (>= 0) from the provided List<Integer>; if none are found, return null. It stops at the first match and returns immediately. Assumes a non-null list with non-null elements; otherwise a NullPointerException may occur.

mbpp_0377.reference_description: Write a java function to remove all occurrences of a character in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove all occurrences of a character in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Remove a specific character from a string
Main goal: Return a new string formed from s with all occurrences of the given character c removed. It iterates over s, appends all characters except c to a StringBuilder, and returns the resulting string.

mbpp_0380.reference_description: Write a function to generate a two-dimensional array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to generate a two-dimensional array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: MultiListGenerator
Main goal: generate and return a 2D int array of size rowNum x colNum where each cell [row][col] contains the product of its row and column indices (row * col), effectively creating a multiplication-grid.

mbpp_0436.reference_description: Write a java function to print negative numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to print negative numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: NegNos — Find first negative number in a list
Main goal: Given a List<Integer>, iterate in order and return the first element that is negative; if none are negative, return null.

mbpp_0443.reference_description: Write a java function to find the largest negative number from the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the largest negative number from the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Minimum element finder
Goal: Given a non-empty int[] list1, returns the smallest value by scanning the array. Note: the method name largestNeg is misleading and there is no handling for empty inputs.

mbpp_0437.reference_description: Write a function to remove odd characters in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove odd characters in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The method removeOdd takes a string and builds a new string by keeping characters at even 1-based positions (indices 1, 3, 5, ... in 0-based indexing). It iterates through the input, and for each even position, appends the corresponding character to a StringBuilder, returning the result. This effectively removes the odd-positioned characters from the original string.

mbpp_0517.reference_description: Write a java function to find the largest postive number from the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the largest postive number from the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: LargestPos - Maximum value finder for an int array
Main goal: Given a non-empty int array, return the largest element by iterating through all elements and keeping track of the current maximum (O(n) time, O(1) space). Note: it assumes a non-empty input; it will fail if the array is empty.

mbpp_0610.reference_description: Write a java function to remove the k'th element from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove the k'th element from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ListUtils.removeKthElement
Main goal: Return a new list that is a copy of the input list with the k-th element (1-based) removed, without mutating the original; if k is out of range, return the copy unchanged.

mbpp_0633.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of xor of all pairs of numbers in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of xor of all pairs of numbers in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Brute-force Pairwise XOR Sum
Main goal: Compute the sum of bitwise XORs for all unordered pairs (i, j) in the input array by iterating all pairs with a double loop and accumulating arr[i] ^ arr[j].

mbpp_0666.reference_description: Write a function to count occurrence of a character in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count occurrence of a character in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Character Count Utility
Main goal: Implement countChar to return the number of times a specified character appears in a string by iterating through all characters and counting matches.

mbpp_0567.reference_description: Write a function to check whether a specified array is sorted or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether a specified array is sorted or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: SortUtils.isSortedList. Main goal: Determine whether a List<T> of Comparable elements is sorted in non-decreasing order by iterating adjacent pairs and returning true if all are in order, otherwise false.

mbpp_0695.reference_description: Write a function to check if each element of the second tuple is greater than its corresponding index in the first tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if each element of the second tuple is greater than its corresponding index in the first tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Prefix-wise strict less-than comparison between two arrays
Main goal: Return true if every corresponding element in testArr1 is strictly less than the element in testArr2 for all indices up to the shorter array length; return false if any pair violates testArr1[i] < testArr2[i].

mbpp_0667.reference_description: Write a java function to count number of vowels in the string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count number of vowels in the string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: VowelCounter
Main goal: Provide a utility method to count how many characters in a given string are vowels, based on a supplied set of vowel characters.

Notes: The CheckVow method takes a string to analyze and a string containing vowel characters. It iterates over each character of the input string and increments a counter whenever the character appears in the vowels string, returning the final count.

mbpp_0807.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first odd number in a given array of numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first odd number in a given array of numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Locate and return the first odd integer in the provided list; if no odd numbers exist, return -1.

mbpp_0741.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether all the characters are same or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether all the characters are same or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: AllCharactersSame — Main goal: determine whether every character in the input string is identical by comparing each character to the first character and returning true if all match, false otherwise.

mbpp_0897.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the word is present in a given sentence or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the word is present in a given sentence or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
WordChecker — Word Presence Checker
