Goal: determine if a specified word exists in a sentence.
The isWordPresent method splits the sentence by spaces into tokens and returns true if any token exactly equals the given word; otherwise it returns false.

mbpp_0909.reference_description: Write a function to find the previous palindrome of a specified number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the previous palindrome of a specified number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: PreviousPalindrome; Main goal: Return the largest palindrome number less than the input num, or 0 if none exists. It iterates downward from num-1 and checks each number by converting to a string and comparing it to its reverse.

mbpp_0809.reference_description: Write a function to check if each element of second tuple is smaller than its corresponding index in first tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if each element of second tuple is smaller than its corresponding index in first tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise comparison of two int arrays
Main goal: Check if every corresponding element in testTup1 is strictly greater than the element in testTup2, up to the shorter array length; returns true if so, otherwise false. If the arrays share no elements (one is empty), returns true.

mbpp_0942.reference_description: Write a function to check if any array element is present in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if any array element is present in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Contains any common element between two lists
Main goal: Provide a generic method to check if testList contains at least one element from checkList. It iterates over checkList and returns true as soon as an element from checkList is found in testList; if no elements match, it returns false.
Functionality: checkElement(List<T> testList, List<T> checkList) uses a for-each over checkList and testList.contains(ele) to test membership.
Notes: Type-safe generic method.

mbpp_0675.reference_description: Write a function to add two integers. however, if the sum is between the given range it will return 20.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add two integers. however, if the sum is between the given range it will return 20.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SumNums – conditional replacement of the sum
Main goal: Compute x + y and return 20 if the sum lies in the inclusive lower bound and exclusive upper bound [m, n); otherwise return the actual sum.

mbpp_0260.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth newman–shanks–williams prime number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth newman–shanks–williams prime number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Newman–Shanks–Williams sequence calculator (recursive)
Main goal: Compute the nth Newman–Shanks–Williams number a_n defined by a_0 = a_1 = 1 and a_n = 2*a_{n-1} + a_{n-2}, returning the result as a BigInteger. It uses a naive recursive approach (no memoization), which is inefficient for large n.

mbpp_0955.reference_description: Write a function to find out, if the given number is abundant.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find out, if the given number is abundant.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Abundant Number Checker
Main goal: Determine whether a given integer n is abundant by summing all of its proper divisors (positive divisors less than n that divide n) and returning true if that sum exceeds n.

mbpp_0960.reference_description: Write a function to solve tiling problem.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to solve tiling problem.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Naive Fibonacci calculator disguised as tiling helper
Main goal: Compute the nth Fibonacci number using simple recursion (F(0)=0, F(1)=1). The method name implies tiling counts, but the implementation returns Fibonacci numbers and is exponential without memoization.

mbpp_0796.reference_description: Write function to find the sum of all items in the given map.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write function to find the sum of all items in the given map.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of Map Integer Values
Main goal: Implement a utility method that returns the sum of all Integer values in a Map by iterating over map.values() and accumulating into an int.
Notes: Uses autounboxing; may throw NullPointerException if the map is null or any value is null. Returns 0 for an empty map.

mbpp_0713.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains all valid values or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains all valid values or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: All-True Array Validator
Main goal: Provides a function checkValid that returns true only if every element in the input boolean array testTup is true; it iterates through the array and returns false on the first encountered false, otherwise true (note: may throw NullPointerException if testTup is null).

mbpp_0790.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether every even index contains even numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether every even index contains even numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Parity-by-Index Checker
Main goal: Determine whether each element in an integer array has the same parity (even or odd) as its index. The method iterates through the array and returns false on the first mismatch (nums[i] % 2 != i % 2); if no mismatches are found, it returns true.

mbpp_0775.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether every odd index contains odd numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether every odd index contains odd numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Parity-by-index Validator
Main goal: Determine if each element's parity matches its index parity (even indices contain even numbers, odd indices contain odd numbers). Returns true if all positions match; false otherwise. Time: O(n), Space: O(1).

mbpp_0802.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of rotations required to generate a sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of rotations required to generate a sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: RotationCounter — Determine the index where a rotated sorted array breaks its ascending order. Main goal: iterate and return i where arr[i] < arr[i-1] (the rotation point); if no such i exists, return 0 (array is not rotated or too short).

mbpp_0833.reference_description: Write a function to get map keys as array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to get map keys as array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Extracts the keys from the given Map<K, ?> and returns them as a List<K>. It iterates over the map's keySet, collects each key into a new ArrayList, and returns that list. The values are ignored, and the resulting order follows the map's key iteration order (depends on the Map implementation).

mbpp_0804.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the product of numbers is even or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the product of numbers is even or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Determine if the product of the first n elements is even
Main goal: Return true if any of the first n elements in arr is even (i.e., the product of these elements is even); otherwise return false. It detects even numbers using a bitwise check and exits early when found.

mbpp_0808.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given tuples contain the k or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given tuples contain the k or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Checks whether a given array contains a specified element by iterating through the array and comparing each element with the provided value using equals. It's a generic method that works for any reference type T, returning true if a match is found and false otherwise. Note potential NullPointerException if the array or its elements are null. Complexity: O(n).

mbpp_0890.reference_description: Write a java function to find the index of an extra element present in one sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the index of an extra element present in one sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Main goal: Determine the index of the extra element in the first array compared to the second by comparing elements up to n; it returns the first index where arr1[i] != arr2[i], or n if all first n elements match (indicating the extra element is at position n in arr1). The code defines a helper class ExtraElementFinder with a static method findExtra that implements this logic.

mbpp_0908.reference_description: Write a function to find the fixed point in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the fixed point in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Fixed Point Finder
Main goal: Linearly search an array to find an index i such that arr[i] == i; return that index or -1 if no such fixed point exists.

mbpp_0084.reference_description: Write a function to find the n-th number in newman conway sequence.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the n-th number in newman conway sequence.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Newman–Conway sequence calculator
Main goal: Compute the nth term of the Newman–Conway sequence where a(1) = a(2) = 1 and a(n) = a(a(n−1)) + a(n−a(n−1)), implemented via direct recursive calls in the sequence(n) function.

mbpp_0889.reference_description: Write a function to reverse each array in a given array of arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to reverse each array in a given array of arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: In-place descending sort of inner lists
Main goal: For a List<List<T>> (where T is Comparable), sort each inner list in descending order in place and return the same outer list reference.

mbpp_0873.reference_description: Write a function to solve the fibonacci sequence using recursion.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to solve the fibonacci sequence using recursion.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive Fibonacci Calculator
Main goal: Compute the nth Fibonacci number using naive recursion: F(1) = F(2) = 1; F(n) = F(n-1) + F(n-2). It’s a straightforward Java implementation but inefficient (exponential time) and lacks input validation for n ≤ 0.

mbpp_0198.reference_description: Write a function to find the largest triangle that can be inscribed in an ellipse.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the largest triangle that can be inscribed in an ellipse.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: EllipseUtils.largestTriangle
Main goal: Given two non-negative parameters a and b (ellipse-related quantities), compute and return the value (3√3 * a^2) / (4 * b); if either a or b is negative, return -1. The method uses a simple guard and a closed-form expression to derive a specific ellipse-related quantity.

mbpp_0081.reference_description: Write a function to zip the two given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to zip the two given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ZipTuples
Main goal: Create a List<Pair<T,U>> by zipping two input lists. For each index i in the first list, pair testTup1.get(i) with testTup2.get(i % testTup2.size()), effectively cycling the second list if it is shorter, and return the collection of Pair objects.

mbpp_0934.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth delannoy number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth delannoy number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Delannoy Number Calculator; Goal: recursively compute Delannoy numbers D(n,m) with base cases D(0,m)=D(n,0)=1 using D(n,m)=D(n-1,m)+D(n-1,m-1)+D(n,m-1); note the code swaps arguments in the first recursive call, but due to symmetry D(n,m)=D(m,n), it still yields correct results, albeit with exponential time without memoization.

mbpp_0951.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum of similar indices in two arrays of tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum of similar indices in two arrays of tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Pair-wise maxima of two lists of pairs
Main goal: Given two lists of Pair<Integer, Integer>, build a new list where each element i is a Pair whose first component is the maximum of the two input firsts and whose second component is the maximum of the two input seconds, processed up to the shorter list length.

mbpp_0391.reference_description: Write a function to convert more than one array to nested map.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert more than one array to nested map.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Converter; Main goal: Transform three aligned lists (K, V, W) into a List<Map<K, Map<V, W>>> by pairing elements at each index into a nested map structure: outer map from K to an inner map from V to W. It uses the minimum of the three sizes to avoid index errors and builds one entry per index.

mbpp_0766.reference_description: Write a function to iterate over all pairs of consecutive items in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to iterate over all pairs of consecutive items in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a generic Pair<T,U> class and a static method pairWise that, given a List<T>, returns a List<Pair<T, T>> containing consecutive pairs of adjacent elements (list[i], list[i+1]) for i from 0 to size-2. If the input list has fewer than 2 elements, it returns an empty list; null inputs are not handled and will throw an exception.

mbpp_0061.reference_description: Write a java function to count number of substrings with the sum of digits equal to their length.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count number of substrings with the sum of digits equal to their length.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Substring count where digit-sum equals substring length
Main goal: For a numeric string s, count substrings whose digits sum equals the substring length. The code transforms each digit to (digit - 1) and counts subarrays with sum zero by maintaining prefix sums A[k] = sum_{t<k}(s[t]-'0'-1) in a hashmap, starting with A[0] = 0. The result is the total number of pairs of equal prefix sums, i.e., substrings where the total deviation from 1 per digit sums to zero.

mbpp_0545.reference_description: Write a java function to toggle only first and last bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to toggle only first and last bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Toggle the first and last set bits of an integer
Main goal: The code computes a mask that has 1s at the least significant bit (bit 0) and at the most significant set bit of n (position h), via takeLAndFSetBits, which effectively yields 2^h + 1. Then toggleFAndLBits flips those two bits in n by XOR-ing with that mask (with a special case: if n == 1, it returns 0).

mbpp_0194.reference_description: Write a java function to convert octal number to decimal number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert octal number to decimal number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: OctalToDecimal converter. Goal: Convert an octal-represented integer into its decimal value by summing each digit times the corresponding power of 8 (processing digits from least significant). Assumes digits are 0–7; no input validation.

mbpp_0735.reference_description: Write a java function to toggle bits of the number except the first and the last bit.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to toggle bits of the number except the first and the last bit.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BitToggler – Flip the middle bits of an integer

Main goal: Provide a pair of methods that identify and flip only the “middle” bits of an integer n (i.e., all bits between the least significant bit 0 and the most significant set bit of n). setMiddleBits(n) builds a mask with 1s in positions 1 through (highestSetBit(n)−1) and 0s at bits 0 and highestSetBit(n); toggleMiddleBits(n) then returns n XOR mask, effectively toggling those middle bits while leaving the end bits unchanged. A special case for n == 1 returns 1 to avoid flipping when there are no middle bits.

mbpp_0669.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the given ip address is valid or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the given ip address is valid or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Validate IPv4 addresses. The class IPValidator compiles a regex for IPv4 addresses into a Pattern and provides checkIP(String ip) which returns "Valid IP address" when the input matches the regex, otherwise "Invalid IP address".

mbpp_0801.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of equal numbers from three given integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of equal numbers from three given integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Three-number equality classifier
Main goal: Determine how many distinct values exist among x, y, z using a HashSet, returning 0 when all are different, 2 when exactly two are equal, and 3 when all three are equal.

mbpp_0905.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of squares of binomial co-efficients.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of squares of binomial co-efficients.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines two static methods operating with BigInteger. factorial(start, end) returns the product of all integers from start to end (inclusive). sumOfSquare(n) computes numerator = product(n+1..2n) and denominator = product(1..n), then returns numerator / denominator, which equals (2n)! / n! = (n+1)(n+2)...(2n). The method name is misleading: it does not sum squares but produces a central factorial product using BigInteger to avoid overflow.

mbpp_0007.reference_description: Write a function to find all words which are at least 4 characters long in a string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all words which are at least 4 characters long in a string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexUtils.findCharLong
Goal: Return all words of length 4 or more from the input text as a list.
How: Compiles a regex for word boundaries with at least 4 word characters (\\b\\w{4,}\\b), iterates over all matches, collects each matched word into a List<String>, and returns the list.

mbpp_0857.reference_description: Write a function to array out the array of given strings individually using map function.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to array out the array of given strings individually using map function.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Convert strings to character lists
Main goal: Transform a List<String> into a List<List<Character>> by splitting each string into its individual characters.
How it works: Uses streams to map each input string to a new List<Character> containing its characters, then collects the results into a list of lists.

mbpp_0647.reference_description: Write a function to split a string at uppercase letters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to split a string at uppercase letters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: StringSplitter
Main goal: Provide a utility (splitUpperString) that splits a CamelCase/PascalCase string into its constituent words by matching segments that start with an uppercase letter followed by non-uppercase characters, and returns them as a list of strings.

mbpp_0033.reference_description: Write a java function to convert a decimal number to binary number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert a decimal number to binary number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DecimalToBinaryConverter
Main goal: Convert a non-negative integer N into a long whose decimal digits form the binary representation of N (e.g., 6 -> 110) by repeatedly dividing N by 2 and placing each bit at the appropriate 10^k position.
Notes: Returns 0 for N = 0; does not handle negative inputs; may overflow for larger N since the result is stored as a long.

mbpp_0578.reference_description: Write a function to interleave arrays of the same length.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to interleave arrays of the same length.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Interleaver.interleaveLists
Main goal: Create a new list by interleaving elements from three input lists of the same type and length, producing [list1[0], list2[0], list3[0], list1[1], list2[1], list3[1], ...]. The method is generic, preallocates capacity, and assumes non-null, equal-length lists; it will fail if any list is null or lengths differ, and extra elements in list2/list3 beyond list1's length are ignored.

mbpp_0467.reference_description: Write a java function to convert decimal number to octal number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert decimal number to octal number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: DecimalToOctal — Converts a non-negative decimal integer to its octal representation and returns it as a decimal integer whose digits are the octal digits (e.g., 10 becomes 12). It repeatedly divides by 8, uses the remainder as the next octal digit, and accumulates digits with powers of 10.

mbpp_0670.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether a sequence of numbers has a decreasing trend or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether a sequence of numbers has a decreasing trend or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: TrendChecker - Main goal: determine if a list of integers is already sorted in non-decreasing (ascending) order by comparing it to a sorted copy; note that the method name suggests a decreasing trend, though the logic checks for ascending order.

mbpp_0950.reference_description: Write a function to display sign of the chinese zodiac for given year.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to display sign of the chinese zodiac for given year.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Chinese Zodiac Calculator anchored to 2000
Main goal: Given a year, compute its Chinese zodiac sign by using (year - 2000) mod 12 (adjusting negatives) and selecting the corresponding sign from a 12-element array (2000 = Dragon, 2001 = Snake, etc.).

mbpp_0734.reference_description: Write a java function to find sum of products of all possible subarrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find sum of products of all possible subarrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of all contiguous subarray products
Goal: Compute the sum of the products of all contiguous subarrays of the given array by iterating from right to left, using incr = arr[i] * (1 + res) where res is the sum of subarray products starting at the next index, and accumulating these increments into the total answer.

mbpp_0719.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatch - Simple regex-based presence check
Main goal: Use the regex "ab*?" to determine if the input text contains an 'a' (followed by zero or more 'b's in a non-greedy way); return "Found a match!" if such a match exists, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0015.reference_description: Write a function to split a string at lowercase letters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to split a string at lowercase letters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: StringSplitter. Main goal: Use a regex [a-z][^a-z]* to extract and return all substrings that start with a lowercase letter followed by non-lowercase characters from the input text as a list.

mbpp_0044.reference_description: Write a function that matches a word at the beginning of a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a word at the beginning of a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher – Start-of-Text Word Character Check
Main goal: Determine if the input string begins with one or more word characters using the regex ^\w+. Returns "Found a match!" when such a sequence is found at the start, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0056.reference_description: Write a java function to check if a given number is one less than twice its reverse.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check if a given number is one less than twice its reverse.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Digit Reversal and Numeric Relation Checker
Main goal: Provide two utilities—rev(num) reverses the decimal digits of a positive integer, and check(n) tests whether 2 * rev(n) equals n + 1 (i.e., whether the reversed number doubled matches the original plus one). The class serves as a small utility for testing a specific digit-reversal relation, with no execution by itself.

mbpp_0024.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given binary number to its decimal equivalent.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given binary number to its decimal equivalent.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Converts a binary number supplied as an int (digits 0/1) into its decimal value by iterating over decimal digits, multiplying each by 2^position and summing them. Assumes digits are 0/1 and may overflow for large inputs.

mbpp_0300.reference_description: Write a function to find the count of all binary sequences of length 2n such that sum of first n bits is same as sum of last n bits.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the count of all binary sequences of length 2n such that sum of first n bits is same as sum of last n bits.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Central binomial coefficient via sum of squares of binomial coefficients
Main goal: For a given n, compute sum_{r=0}^n (C(n, r))^2 by iteratively updating C(n, r) and accumulating its square; the result equals C(2n, n) (central binomial coefficient).

mbpp_0254.reference_description: Write a function to find all words starting with 'a' or 'e' in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all words starting with 'a' or 'e' in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class AEWordsFinder with a method wordsAE(String text) that uses a regular expression [ae]\\w+ to find all substrings starting with a lowercase 'a' or 'e' followed by one or more word characters, returning them as a list of strings.

mbpp_0151.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the given number is co-prime or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the given number is co-prime or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CoprimeChecker - GCD and Coprimality Check
Main goal: Provide a utility to compute the greatest common divisor of two integers (gcd) using the Euclidean algorithm, and to check if two integers are coprime by evaluating whether gcd(x, y) == 1.

mbpp_0330.reference_description: Write a function to find all three, four, five characters long words in the given string by using regex.

Main goal: Given a text, return a list of all substrings that are whole words of length 3 to 5 (inclusive). It uses regex "\\b\\w{3,5}\\b" to collect every matching word (including digits and underscores) in the input string and returns them as a List<String>.

mbpp_0406.reference_description: Write a java function to find the parity of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the parity of a given number.

Title: ParityFinder - Odd vs Even Parity of a 32-bit integer
Main goal: Determine whether x has an odd or even number of 1-bits and return "Odd Parity" or "Even Parity". It folds the 32-bit value using successive XOR and right-shifts to reduce to a single bit that represents parity.

mbpp_0434.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by one or more b's.

(an 'a' followed by one or more 'b's, with a reluctant quantifier) to search the input. If a matching substring exists, it returns "Found a match!"; otherwise it returns "Not matched!".

Main goal: Use a regular expression to verify if the input text ends with a non-whitespace sequence (a word possibly followed by non-space characters) and return "Found a match!" if such a pattern exists, otherwise "Not matched!".

Title: Regex-based z-substring matcher
Goal: Given a string, check for a substring that matches the regex \w*z.\w* (optional word chars, a 'z', any single following character, then optional word chars). Returns "Found a match!" if present, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0482.reference_description: Write a function to find sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters in the given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters in the given string by using regex.

Main goal: Determine if the given text contains a trailing segment that matches one or more uppercase letters followed by one or more lowercase letters (pattern [A-Z]+[a-z]+$); returns "Yes" when such a match is found, otherwise "No".

mbpp_0563.reference_description: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of a string.

mbpp_0573.reference_description: Write a java function to calculate the product of the unique numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to calculate the product of the unique numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: UniqueProduct – Product of distinct numbers
Main goal: Given a list of integers, compute the product of the unique elements (duplicates removed via a HashSet) and return the result as a long.

mbpp_0737.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the given string is starting with a vowel or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the given string is starting with a vowel or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: String prefix validator: starts with a vowel and followed by word characters
Main goal: Determine if a given string begins with a vowel (case-insensitive) and is followed by zero or more letters, digits, or underscores, returning "Valid" when this prefix exists, otherwise "Invalid". Note: uses Matcher.find() with a leading-anchor pattern, so trailing characters outside the allowed set do not affect the result.

mbpp_0584.reference_description: Write a function to find all adverbs and their positions in a given sentence by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all adverbs and their positions in a given sentence by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: AdverbFinder.findAdverbs
Main goal: Scan a text to find words ending with "ly" and return a list describing each match by its start index, end index, and the matched word.

mbpp_0648.reference_description: Write a function to exchange the position of every n-th value with (n+1)th value and (n+1)th value with n-th value in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to exchange the position of every n-th value with (n+1)th value and (n+1)th value with n-th value in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Swap adjacent elements in a list
Main goal: The method exchangeElements takes a List<T>, copies it to a new ArrayList, and swaps every adjacent pair of elements (indices 0 and 1, 2 and 3, etc.). If the list has an odd length, the last element remains in place. It returns the resulting list.

mbpp_0725.reference_description: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of the given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of the given string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: extract all substrings enclosed in double quotes from a given string. The code defines extractQuotation(text) which uses the regex "\"(.*?)\"" to non-greedily capture text inside quotes and returns a list of these contents. It iterates with Matcher.find() and collects group(1) for each quoted segment. Caveats: it doesn’t handle escaped quotes, and by default the dot does not match line breaks (DOTALL not set).

mbpp_0785.reference_description: Write a function to convert tuple string to integer tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert tuple string to integer tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleConverter class and tupleStrInt method
Main goal: Convert a string representation of a numeric tuple into an int array by removing parentheses and ellipses, splitting on ", " and converting each token to an int.

mbpp_0756.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or one 'b'.

Main goal: Determine if the input text contains the substring "a" or "ab" using the pattern "ab?" and return "Found a match!" if such a substring exists, otherwise "Not matched!". The code compiles the regex, creates a matcher for the input text, uses find(), and returns the appropriate message.

mbpp_0749.reference_description: Write a function to sort a given array of strings of numbers numerically.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sort a given array of strings of numbers numerically.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Converts each numeric string to an int, collects them into a List<Integer>, sorts the list with Collections.sort, and returns the sorted list (strings must be valid integers).

mbpp_0787.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by three 'b'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by three 'b'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher — regex-based substring check
Main goal: Provide a static method textMatchThree that checks whether the input string contains the sequence "abbb" (an 'a' followed by three 'b's) using a regex pattern ab{3}?, returning "Found a match!" if found and "Not matched!" otherwise. mbpp_0917.reference_description: Write a function to find the sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters.

Main goal: Check if the input text ends with a sequence of one or more uppercase letters followed by one or more lowercase letters using the regex "[A-Z]+[a-z]+$"; returns "Found a match!" if it matches, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0930.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's by using regex.

Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexMatcher - Checks for an 'a' (optionally followed by 'b's) in text
Main goal: Provides a static method textMatch(text) that uses the regex "ab*?" to determine if the input contains an 'a' (with zero or more 'b's, non-greedy). If a match exists, it returns "Found a match!"; otherwise it returns "Not matched!".

mbpp_0906.reference_description: Write a function to extract year, month and date from a url by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract year, month and date from a url by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code provides a DateExtractor class with a static method extractDate that searches a URL string for path segments in the /YYYY/MM/DD/ format using a regex, and returns all matches as a list of string arrays containing year, month, and day.

mbpp_0088.reference_description: Write a function to get the frequency of the elements in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to get the frequency of the elements in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the frequency of each distinct element in a generic list. The static method freqCount takes a List<T> and returns a Map<T, Integer> mapping each element to its number of occurrences, using a HashMap and updating counts with getOrDefault while iterating the list.

mbpp_0036.reference_description: Write a java function to find the nth digit in the proper fraction of two given numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the nth digit in the proper fraction of two given numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Nth decimal digit finder for a fraction
Main goal: Compute the N-th digit after the decimal point in the decimal expansion of the fraction p/q by simulating long division. Each iteration multiplies the current remainder p by 10, derives the next digit as res = (p*10)/q, updates the remainder with p = (p*10) % q, and repeats N times. The final res is returned. Note: behavior is conventional when 0 <= p < q; otherwise digits may exceed 9.

mbpp_0251.reference_description: Write a function to insert an element before each element of array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to insert an element before each element of array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Interleave a fixed element before each item in a list.

Main goal: Given a list and an element, produce a new list where the element is inserted before every element of the input list (e.g., [a, b, c] with element e becomes [e, a, e, b, e, c]); the original list is not modified.

mbpp_0273.reference_description: Write a function to substract the contents of one tuple with corresponding index of other tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to substract the contents of one tuple with corresponding index of other tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise subtraction of two integer lists
Main goal: Create and return a new list containing the element-wise differences (list1[i] - list2[i]) for i from 0 to min(list1.size(), list2.size()), effectively ignoring any extra elements if the lists differ in length.

mbpp_0285.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by two to three 'b'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by two to three 'b'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher – detects "abb" or "abbb" in a string
Main goal: The textMatchTwoThree method compiles a regex "ab{2,3}" (an 'a' followed by two or three 'b's), checks if the input text contains such a substring using Matcher.find(), and returns "Found a match!" if found or "Not matched!" otherwise.

mbpp_0314.reference_description: Write a function to find out the maximum sum such that no two chosen numbers are adjacent for the given rectangular grid of dimension 2 x n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find out the maximum sum such that no two chosen numbers are adjacent for the given rectangular grid of dimension 2 x n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Summary_description
Title: Maximum sum in a 2xN grid with no adjacent columns

Main goal: Given a 2-by-N grid, compute the maximum possible sum by selecting at most one cell per column such that no two selected cells come from adjacent columns; in each chosen column you take the larger of the two cells.

Explanation: The code reduces the problem to a 1D house-robber dynamic programming on an array where a[i] = max(grid[0][i], grid[1][i]). It uses two variables: incl (best sum including the current column) and excl (best sum excluding it). Initialization uses the first column, and the loop updates incl and excl for each subsequent column, finally returning the maximum of incl and excl.

Complexity: Time O(n), Space O(1).

mbpp_0319.reference_description: Write a function to find all five characters long word in the given string by using regex.

mbpp_0320.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the difference between the squared sum of first n natural numbers and the sum of squared first n natural numbers.

Description_Simple.comparison_text: SumDifference: Computes the difference between the square of the sum and the sum of squares of the first n natural numbers. It iterates from 1 to n, accumulates sumOfSquares (sum of i^2) and squareOfSum (sum of i), then returns (sum of 1..n)^2 − sum of i^2 as a long.

mbpp_0643.reference_description: Write a function that matches a word containing 'z', not at the start or end of the word.

Main goal: The code checks whether an input string contains a lowercase 'z' that is not at a word boundary (i.e., a 'z' inside a word) using the regex \Bz\B, and returns "Found a match!" if such a case exists, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0656.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum sum of absolute differences of two arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum sum of absolute differences of two arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Sorts both input arrays a and b, then computes the sum of absolute differences between corresponding elements (a[i] - b[i]) for i from 0 to n-1, returning that total. This effectively pairs elements after sorting to minimize the sum of absolute differences between the two sequences.

mbpp_0539.reference_description: Write a function to create array containing the power of said number in bases raised to the corresponding number in the index using map function.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to create array containing the power of said number in bases raised to the corresponding number in the index using map function.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes element-wise exponentiation: given two lists of Doubles (basesNum and index), it pairs elements up to the shorter list length and returns a new list where each element is base^exponent (Math.pow). If the lists differ in size, the extra elements are ignored; there are no null checks for inputs.

mbpp_0444.reference_description: Write a function to trim each tuple by k in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to trim each tuple by k in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Purpose: trimTuple trims K elements from both ends of every inner list in testList and returns a string representation of the resulting list.

How: For each inner list ele of size N, it creates ele.subList(K, N-K) (i.e., removes the first K and last K elements) and collects these trimmed lists into res.

Result: Returns res.toString() — a String representation of the list of trimmed lists. Assumes each inner list has length at least 2K; otherwise subList(K, N-K) may throw an exception.

mbpp_0759.reference_description: Write a function to check a decimal with a precision of 2.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check a decimal with a precision of 2.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:

mbpp_0674.reference_description: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given string using collections module.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given string using collections module.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RemoveDuplicateWords
Main goal: Remove duplicate words from a sentence while preserving their first-occurrence order.
How it works: The removeDuplicate method splits the input on whitespace, inserts each word into a LinkedHashSet (which ensures uniqueness and preserves insertion order), and then joins the unique words back into a single string with spaces.

mbpp_0794.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by anything, ending in 'b'.

mbpp_0016.reference_description: Write a function to find sequences of lowercase letters joined with an underscore.

mbpp_0944.reference_description: Write a function to separate and print the numbers and their position of a given string.

mbpp_0956.reference_description: Write a function to split the given string at uppercase letters by using regex.

mbpp_0019.reference_description: Write a function to find whether a given array of integers contains any duplicate element.

Title: DuplicateChecker - Detect duplicates in an int array
Main goal: Determine if an input int[] contains duplicate values by inserting elements into a HashSet and comparing the array length with the set size; returns true when duplicates exist.

mbpp_0049.reference_description: Write a function to extract every first or specified element from a given two-dimensional array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract every first or specified element from a given two-dimensional array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extract Nth column from a 2D list (generic)
Main goal: Given a List<List<T>> nums and an index N, return a new List<T> containing the N-th element from each inner list (i.e., extract the Nth column). mbpp_0027.reference_description: Write a java function to remove all digits from array of strings.

Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Remove digits from strings in a list. Main goal: Given a List<String>, return a new List<String> where each string has all digits removed (using replaceAll("\\d", "")); the original list remains unmodified.

mbpp_0021.reference_description: Write a function to find m number of multiples of n.

Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Multiples.multiplesOfNum — Generate first m multiples of n

mbpp_0043.reference_description: Write a function to find sequences of lowercase letters joined with an underscore using regex.

Main goal: Check if the input string matches the pattern of lowercase letters, an underscore, then more lowercase letters (^[a-z]+_[a-z]+$); return "Found a match!" when it matches, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0145.reference_description: Write a java function to find the maximum difference between any two elements in a given array.

mbpp_0156.reference_description: Write a function to convert a tuple of string values to a tuple of integer values.

mbpp_0203.reference_description: Write a java function to find the hamming distance between given two integers.

Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Hamming Distance between two integers. Goal: Compute how many bits differ between n1 and n2 by XOR-ing them and counting the set bits.

mbpp_0154.reference_description: Write a function to extract every specified element from a given two dimensional array.

mbpp_0205.reference_description: Write a function to find the inversions of tuple elements in the given tuple array.

mbpp_0236.reference_description: Write a java function to count the maximum number of equilateral triangles that can be formed within a given equilateral triangle.

mbpp_0345.reference_description: Write a function to find the difference between two consecutive numbers in a given array.

mbpp_0206.reference_description: Write a function to perform the adjacent element concatenation in the given tuples.

mbpp_0372.reference_description: Write a function to sort a given array of elements in ascending order using heap queue algorithm.

mbpp_0368.reference_description: Write a function to repeat the given tuple n times.

mbpp_0424.reference_description: Write a function to extract only the rear index element of each string in the given tuple.

mbpp_0433.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the entered number is greater than the elements of the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the entered number is greater than the elements of the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Number vs Array Maximum Checker
Main goal: Sorts the input array and checks if the given number is strictly greater than the array's maximum (the last element after sorting); returns a corresponding message.

mbpp_0456.reference_description: Write a function to reverse strings in a given array of string values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to reverse strings in a given array of string values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Reverse each string in a list
Main goal: Given a List<String>, produce a new List<String> where every string is reversed character by character.
Approach: The reverseStringList method iterates over the input list, reverses each string using StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString(), collects them into a new ArrayList, and returns it.

mbpp_0460.reference_description: Write a java function to get the first element of each sublist.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to get the first element of each sublist.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extractor - First-Element Extraction from a List of Lists
Main goal: Given a List<List<T>>, return a List<T> consisting of the first element from each inner list (assumes each inner list is non-empty).

mbpp_0503.reference_description: Write a function to add consecutive numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add consecutive numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Utils.addConsecutiveNums — Pairwise Sum of Consecutive Elements
Main goal: Given a list of integers, return a new list where each element is the sum of two consecutive elements from the input (nums[i] + nums[i+1]), for all valid i. The result length is input size minus one. The method does not modify the original list; it creates and returns a new list. If the input has fewer than 2 elements, an empty list is returned.

mbpp_0529.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal-lucas number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal-lucas number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Jacobsthal-Lucas Number Calculator (Dynamic Programming)
Main goal: Compute the nth Jacobsthal-Lucas number J(n) using an iterative dynamic programming approach with base values J(0)=2 and J(1)=1 and recurrence J(n)=J(n-1) + 2*J(n-2); the result is returned as an int. The code stores intermediate results in a dp array of size n+1, but it assumes n >= 1 (n=0 would cause an array bound issue).

mbpp_0547.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of hamming distances of all consecutive numbers from o to n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of hamming distances of all consecutive numbers from o to n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the sum of n divided by successive powers of two: n/1 + n/2 + n/4 + n/8 + ... until the quotient becomes zero; it doubles i each loop iteration and accumulates the results in sum.

mbpp_0543.reference_description: Write a function to add two numbers and print number of digits of sum.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add two numbers and print number of digits of sum.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CountDigits
Main goal: Compute the number of decimal digits in the sum of two integers by repeatedly dividing the sum by 10 until it becomes 0; returns 0 for non-positive sums and does not handle zero correctly, negative inputs, or potential integer overflow.

mbpp_0536.reference_description: Write a function to select the nth items of array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to select the nth items of array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: nthItems utility
Main goal: Provide a generic utility method that returns a new list containing every nth element from the input list, starting at index 0.
How it works: nthItems<T>(List<T> list, int n) creates a new ArrayList<T>, iterates with i = 0; i < list.size(); i += n, adds list.get(i) to the result, and returns the result.

mbpp_0551.reference_description: Write a function to extract a specified column from a given nested array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract a specified column from a given nested array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: In-place column extraction from a matrix-like list. Main goal: Given a List<List<T>> representing rows, remove the element at index n from each row and collect those removed elements into a new List<T>, effectively extracting the nth column while mutating the original rows (may throw index errors if n is invalid).

mbpp_0690.reference_description: Write a function to multiply consecutive numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to multiply consecutive numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Consecutive Pair Product Calculator
Main goal: Given a list of integers, produce a new list where each element is the product of two consecutive numbers from the input (i.e., multiply nums[i] by nums[i+1] for i from 0 to size-2).

mbpp_0724.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the sum of all digits of the base to the specified power.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate the sum of all digits of the base to the specified power.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: PowerBaseSum — Main goal: calculate base^power with BigInteger and return the sum of the decimal digits of that result.

mbpp_0565.reference_description: Write a java function to split a string into characters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to split a string into characters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Character-wise string to list converter
Main goal: Given an input string, produce a List<String> where each element is a single-character string representing the corresponding character in the input, preserving order.

mbpp_0825.reference_description: Write a java function to access multiple elements of specified index from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to access multiple elements of specified index from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Generic element extractor from a list
Main goal: Provide a generic utility method accessElements that, given a list of items and a list of indices, returns a new list containing the elements of the input list at the specified indices, preserving order.

mbpp_0763.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum difference between any two elements in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum difference between any two elements in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code finds the minimum difference between any two elements in an array by sorting the array and checking the differences between each pair of adjacent elements, returning the smallest gap (0 if duplicates exist). Note: for arrays with fewer than two elements, it returns Integer.MAX_VALUE.

mbpp_0728.reference_description: Write a function to sum elements in two arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sum elements in two arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise sum of two integer lists
Main goal: Create and return a new list where each element is the sum of the corresponding elements from lst1 and lst2 (assuming equal length).

mbpp_0774.reference_description: Write a function to check if the string is a valid email address or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the string is a valid email address or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: It defines a simple email validator. The EmailValidator class uses a regex (^[a-z0-9]+[\\._]?[a-z0-9]+[@]\\w+[.]\\w{2,3}$) to determine if a given string is an email. The checkEmail method returns "Valid Email" when Pattern.matches(REGEX, email) is true, otherwise it returns "Invalid Email".

mbpp_0902.reference_description: Write a function to combine two maps by adding values for common keys.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to combine two maps by adding values for common keys.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Merge two dictionaries by summing values
Goal: Produce a new map containing all keys from both input maps; for keys present in both, sum their Integer values; for keys present in only one map, include that key's value.

mbpp_0116.reference_description: Write a function to convert a given tuple of positive integers into an integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert a given tuple of positive integers into an integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleToIntUtil - Concatenate ints into a BigInteger
Main goal: Convert an array of integers into a single BigInteger by concatenating the decimal representations of each element in order, returning the result as a BigInteger. Note: it does not handle empty input (will throw if the array is empty).

mbpp_0098.reference_description: Write a function to multiply all the numbers in array and divide with the length of the array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to multiply all the numbers in array and divide with the length of the array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the product of all numbers in a List<Double> and then divides by the list size, effectively returning (product of elements) / n. Not a valid average or geometric mean; it can fail on empty lists (division by zero) or null elements (unboxing NPE).

mbpp_0076.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the total number of axis-aligned squares in an m-by-n grid. It first ensures m ≤ n (swapping if needed), then returns the closed-form count: m(m+1)(2m+1)/6 + (n−m)m(m+1)/2, accounting for all square sizes.

mbpp_0197.reference_description: Write a function to perform the exponentiation of the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the exponentiation of the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise exponentiation of two arrays
Main goal: Return a new array where each element i is testTup1[i] raised to the power of testTup2[i], computed up to the smaller length of the two input arrays.

mbpp_0224.reference_description: Write a java function to count set bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count set bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BitCounter - Counts set bits in an integer
Main goal: Provide countSetBits(int n) to compute how many 1-bits are in n by iterating through bits (adding the least significant bit and shifting right) until the value becomes zero; note potential infinite loop for negative inputs due to arithmetic right shift—use unsigned shift (>>>) or restrict n to non-negative values.

mbpp_0261.reference_description: Write a function to perform mathematical division operation across the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform mathematical division operation across the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise integer division of two arrays
Main goal: Given two int arrays, produce a new int array containing the element-wise quotient of corresponding elements, computed up to the minimum length of the inputs using integer division, and return it.

mbpp_0213.reference_description: Write a function to perform the concatenation of two string tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the concatenation of two string tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise concatenation of two string arrays
Main goal: Given two String arrays, produce a new array where each element i is the concatenation of testTup1[i] and testTup2[i], up to the minimum length of the two inputs.
Functions:
- concatenateStrings(testTup1, testTup2): computes length as the smaller of the two array lengths, creates a result array of that length, fills it with the concatenation testTup1[i] + testTup2[i], and returns the result.

mbpp_0365.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of digits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of digits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DigitCounter - count digits of an integer
Main goal: Provide a static method countDigit(int n) that returns how many decimal digits are in n by repeatedly dividing n by 10 and counting iterations. Note: 0 yields 0 (edge-case); negative numbers are handled by ignoring the sign (they count digits of the magnitude).

mbpp_0271.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n even natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n even natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of fifth powers of the first n even numbers
Main goal: Compute the sum of the fifth powers of the first n even integers, i.e., sum_{i=1}^n (2i)^5, and return the result as a long.

mbpp_0347.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Count total squares in an m x n grid
Main goal: Given two integers m and n, swap them so that m <= n, then compute the total number of axis-aligned squares contained in an m-by-n rectangle (sum of squares of all sizes) using the closed-form formula: n*(n+1)*(3*m - n + 1)/6, returned as a long.

mbpp_0399.reference_description: Write a function to perform the mathematical bitwise xor operation across the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the mathematical bitwise xor operation across the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BitwiseXor - Element-wise XOR of two int arrays
Main goal: Produce an array where each element is the bitwise XOR of the corresponding elements from two input arrays, up to the length of the shorter array.

mbpp_0439.reference_description: Write a function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Converter.multipleToSingle
Main goal: Take a List<Integer>, concatenate the decimal representations of its elements into one string, and parse that string as an int to return the single combined value. It builds the string with a StringBuilder and uses Integer.parseInt on the result. Assumes non-empty input and values that won’t overflow; empty lists or invalid/overflow cases will throw exceptions.

mbpp_0422.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of cubes of first n natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of cubes of first n natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Average of cubes from 1 to n
Main goal: Calculate the average of the cubes 1^3, 2^3, ..., n^3 by summing i^3 for i = 1..n, dividing by n, and rounding the result to six decimal places.

mbpp_0429.reference_description: Write a function to extract the elementwise and tuples from the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract the elementwise and tuples from the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a utility class TupleUtils with a static method andTuples that computes the element-wise bitwise AND of two int arrays. It determines the comparison length as the smaller of the two input lengths, creates a result array of that length, and fills it so that res[i] equals testTup1[i] & testTup2[i]. The resulting array is returned. If the input arrays have different lengths, only the leading portion up to the shorter length is processed.

mbpp_0420.reference_description: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n even natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n even natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
CubeSum Class - Sum of cubes of first n even numbers

Main goal: Compute the total of cubes of the first n even numbers (2, 4, ..., 2n) by iterating and summing (2i)^3 for i from 1 to n.

How it works: The cubeSum method initializes sum to 0, loops i from 1 to n, computes even = 2*i, adds even^3 to sum, and returns sum. Complexity is O(n) time and O(1) extra space. It uses int, so results may overflow for large n; for n <= 0 it returns 0.

mbpp_0449.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the triangle is valid or not if 3 points are given.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the triangle is valid or not if 3 points are given.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Determine if three 2D points form a non-degenerate triangle. The code defines TriangleChecker with a static method checkTriangle(x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3) that computes a = x1*(y2−y3) + x2*(y3−y1) + x3*(y1−y2) (twice the triangle's area via the shoelace formula). If a == 0, the points are collinear and it returns "No"; otherwise it returns "Yes".

mbpp_0494.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given binary tuple to integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given binary tuple to integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Binary digits array to decimal string
Main goal: Convert an array of 0/1 integers into a decimal string by treating the array as binary digits, concatenating them, parsing as base-2, and returning the decimal representation as a string.
What it does: Iterates over testTup, appends each digit to build a binary string, parses that string as base-2 to an int, and returns the resulting value as a string.

mbpp_0500.reference_description: Write a function to concatenate all elements of the given array into a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to concatenate all elements of the given array into a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Concatenator
Goal: Convert a List<String> into a single string by prefixing a space before each element (resulting in a leading space) using StringBuilder for concatenation.

mbpp_0470.reference_description: Write a function to find the pairwise addition of the elements of the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the pairwise addition of the elements of the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Pairwise Adjacent-Sum Array
Goal: Given an integer array, produce a new array where each element is the sum of two consecutive elements from the input (testTup[i] + testTup[i+1]); the resulting array length is one less than the input.

mbpp_0634.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of first n even natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of first n even natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of fourth powers of first n even integers
Main goal: Compute the sum of the fourth powers of the first n even numbers (2, 4, ..., 2n) and return it as a long.
What it does: Iterates i from 1 to n, sets j = 2*i, adds j^4 to the running total.
Complexity: O(n) time, O(1) extra space.

mbpp_0558.reference_description: Write a java function to find the digit distance between two integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the digit distance between two integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Digit Distance - Sum of digits of the absolute difference
Main goal: Given two integers, compute |n1 - n2| and return the sum of the decimal digits of that difference (via digitDistanceNums).

mbpp_0616.reference_description: Write a function to perfom the modulo of tuple elements in the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perfom the modulo of tuple elements in the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Calculates an element-wise modulo between two int arrays up to the length of the shorter array, returning a new array of remainders (and it will throw if any corresponding element of the second array is zero).

mbpp_0549.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n odd natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n odd natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of fifth powers of the first n odd numbers
Main goal: Compute and return the sum of the fifth powers of the first n odd integers: sum_{i=1}^n (2i−1)^5, using a long accumulator.

mbpp_0677.reference_description: Write a function to check if the triangle is valid or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the triangle is valid or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TriangleValidator
Main goal: Determine if three integers can be the angles of a triangle by checking if their sum equals 180 degrees. The method validityTriangle(a, b, c) returns true when a + b + c == 180, otherwise false. Note: It doesn't check positive angles or triangle validity beyond the sum, and could be simplified to return (a + b + c) == 180.

mbpp_0686.reference_description: Write a function to find the frequency of each element in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the frequency of each element in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FrequencyCounter
Main goal: Count the frequency of each distinct element in a given list (of generic type T) and return a string representation of the resulting frequency map.

mbpp_0673.reference_description: Write a java function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.

Title: Concatenate integers into a single integer
Main goal: Given a List<Integer>, append each element's decimal representation to form a string, then parse that string as an int and return it.
Notes: Assumes non-empty input and that the resulting string fits in an int; otherwise may throw exceptions (e.g., NumberFormatException or overflow).

mbpp_0715.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given string of integers into a tuple.

Main goal: Compute the sum of (2i−1)^4 for i = 1 to n using a simple loop (returning a long).

mbpp_0761.reference_description: Write a function to caluclate arc length of an angle.

mbpp_0782.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of all odd length subarrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of all odd length subarrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of all odd-length subarrays
Description: The function oddLengthSum computes the total sum of all elements across all odd-length subarrays of the input array. For each index i, it multiplies arr[i] by the number of odd-length subarrays that include i, which is floor(((i + 1) * (n - i) + 1) / 2), and accumulates this into the result.

mbpp_0768.reference_description: Write a java function to check for odd parity of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check for odd parity of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
ParityChecker: Odd-parity test for integers.
Goal: Return true if the input integer has an odd number of 1-bits by counting set bits with Brian Kernighan's method (clearing the least significant 1-bit via x &= (x - 1)) and checking if the count is odd.

mbpp_0855.reference_description: Write a java function to check for even parity of a given number.

- Main goal: Determine whether an integer has even parity by counting the number of set bits using the bit-trick x = x & (x - 1) (popcount loop) and returning true when the count is even (parity % 2 == 0).

mbpp_0827.reference_description: Write a function to sum a specific column of array in a given array of arrays.

mbpp_0886.reference_description: Write a function to add all the numbers in array and divide it with the length of the array.

mbpp_0837.reference_description: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n odd natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n odd natural numbers.

Main goal: Implement cubeSum(n) to compute the sum 1^3 + 3^3 + 5^3 + ... + (2n−1)^3 by iterating over the first n odd numbers, cubing each, and accumulating the total (returning an int). Note: for large n, integer overflow is possible; the sum also has a closed form n^2(2n^2−1).

mbpp_0894.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given string of float type into tuple.

mbpp_0954.reference_description: Write a function that gives profit amount if the given amount has profit else return none.

mbpp_0919.reference_description: Write a java function to multiply all items in the array.

mbpp_0053.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not.
